query: SELECT ar.id, ar.cliente, ar.empresaNome, ar.valorOriginal, ar.valorLiquido, ar.vencimentoData, ar.tipo, ar.estado, ar.centroDeCustosId, ca.status as cobrancaStatus FROM accounts_receivable ar LEFT JOIN collection_actions ca ON ar.id = ca.receivableId WHERE ar.estado = 'Vencido' LIMIT 5;
